question: Fit a Naive Bayes model on the Breast Cancer Wisconsin dataset using a 70/30 train-test split. Compute and return the test accuracy and the 5x5 pairwise Pearson correlation matrix among the top 5 features most correlated (by absolute value) with the diagnosis label.

expected_output.description: rows as accuracy result (1 row), columns should include Metric, Value
Pearson correlation matrix; columns should include feature (feature name) followed by the 5 selected feature columns
